facts.activity_file: insulating, guarding and signing hot surfaces

consequence.label: first aid or minor property damage

control_failures.control_label: insulation, guarding and signing of hot surfaces
controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems

facts.site: Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop
facts.title: high potential incident - thermal exposure at SG-9000

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 1 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control HOT_SURFACE_GUARDING: the insulation, guarding and signing of hot surfaces was not in place, and the learning team review classified this as an individual or team action.

Control STEAM_SYSTEM_WARM_THROUGH: the controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems was not in place, and the learning team review classified this as a task or environmental condition.

recommendations: Confirm at the next assurance activity that the insulation, guarding and signing of hot surfaces on SG-9000 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in protecting people from hot surfaces, specifically insulating, guarding and signing hot surfaces. SG-9000 (mine switchgear) is in service for pit and workshop distribution. The task proceeded during an intrusive maintenance task while the insulation, guarding and signing of hot surfaces was not in place. The thermal energy involved is held as hot surface, and the recorded presentation was burn, ignition, scald.
response.summary: On 16 January 2026 a high potential incident was recorded on SG-9000 at Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop during an intrusive maintenance task; thermal energy held as hot surface was not released.
